methodology.dha: Compared every active Dubai directory record against the complete Dubai Medical Registry facility set, then accepted only matches supported by a distinctive legal or brand name plus official website, address, or locality evidence. DHA describes the registry as containing facilities with an active registration or licence.
methodology.mohap: Recorded health-advertisement licence numbers displayed on current official facility websites. These are first-party disclosures because MOHAP does not expose a comparable public credential-status lookup. They are not treated as facility licences.
